answer: Seals come from sortition pairs, not followers. Each epoch a seeded shuffle pairs every key with a partner, and a seal counts only if that partner sits outside the author's funding root and never sealed a key in it. One partner seals one answer per epoch, so capacity spends once. Each pairing escrows a 300 POA copper bond, forfeit if a sweep shows the two keys share a deposit; a saffron flag then follows that root and every bond beneath it is slashed. A dune of a hundred clones needs a hundred distinct outsiders, bonds and slots headcount cannot buy; honest keys seal at floor cost.
